```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(itsmr)
```

## Load data

```{r}
dow <- read.csv("dow.csv", header = TRUE)
head(dow)
```

## a) Time Series Plot
```{r} 
# Convert to R date in order to use seq properly
dow$Date <- as.Date(dow$Date, format = "%m/%d/%y")

quarterly_ticks <- seq(as.Date("2010-01-01"), max(dow$Date), by = "3 months")
jan_ticks <- seq(as.Date("2010-01-01"), as.Date("2015-01-01"), by = "1 year")
yearly_ticks <- c(jan_ticks, as.Date("2015-12-31"))
yearly_labels <- c("2010", "2011", "2012", "2013", "2014", "2015", "2016")

add_axis <- function() {
  axis(1, at = yearly_ticks, labels = yearly_labels, cex.axis = 0.8)
  axis(1, at = quarterly_ticks, labels = FALSE, tck = -0.01)
}

plot(dow$Date, dow$Close, 
     type = "l", 
     col = "blue", 
     xaxt = "n",
     main = "Dow Jones Industrial Average (2010 - 2016)",
     xlab = "Month and Year",
     ylab = "Average Price")

add_axis()
```
**<comment on any apparent trend here>**

## b) Linear Trend Fit
```{r}
lin_trend <- trend(dow$Close, p = 1) # Linear Trend
lin_resid  <- dow$Close - lin_trend
```

```{r}
# Time series with quadratic trend
plot(dow$Date, dow$Close, type = "l", col = "blue", xaxt = "n",
     main = "DOW Close with Linear Trend",
     xlab = "Month and Year", ylab = "Closing Price")
lines(dow$Date, lin_trend, col = "red", lwd = 2)
add_axis()
legend("topleft", legend = c("Original", "Linear trend"),
       col = c("blue", "red"), lty = 1, lwd = c(1, 2))
```
**<comment on if residuals appear to be a WN process>**

## c) Sample ACF and Linear Regression Coefficient
```{r}
acf(lin_resid, na.action = na.pass,
    main = "ACF of Linear Residuals on Close Price")
```
